title: Add Dedicated autoscaling bounds dashboards (desired vs bounded, queue depth, prediction error, scale events)
author: Sergio Costa
description: This adds a first-pass Grafana dashboard suite for Dedicated autoscaling bounds + predictive mode. The goal is to make it obvious when (a) the autoscaler wants to scale but is clamped by customer max/min bounds, (b) queue depth/latency is building because we are at max, (c) the predictor is under/over-shooting, and (d) scale events are firing too frequently (oscillation). Dashboards are designed to be usable by SRE/on-call and CS/TAMs during pilots with per-customer + per-deployment drilldowns, while keeping label cardinality bounded (deployment_id is supported; request_id is not). Panels rely on new metrics being emitted by the monorepo PRs (desired vs bounded replicas, bound-hit counters, prediction error series, scale-event reasons). This PR intentionally does not add alerting rules (that’s pr-1941) but includes dashboard annotations and templating aligned to the metric naming standard. Rollout: dashboards are under the Dedicated folder and gated by our standard dashboard provisioning; once merged, they’ll be available in staging immediately and prod after the next observability-pack sync.
commits: Add Dedicated autoscaling bounds dashboard scaffold + variables
Add desired vs bounded replicas panels and bound-hit rate panels
Add queue depth + saturation correlations and SLO context panels
Add prediction vs actual demand and prediction error panels
Add scale event timeline + oscillation indicators and annotations
Docs: add dashboard README + runbook links
dashboard_contents_summary: Dashboards added: (1) Dedicated > Autoscaling Bounds > Overview: per-deployment desired_replicas vs bounded_replicas, min/max bound hit rates (5m + 1h), bounded state % time, queue depth, p95 latency, GPU utilization/saturation. (2) Predictive Mode: forecast_qps vs observed_qps, prediction_error_abs/pct, forecast staleness, fallback_to_reactive counters, and lead-time distribution (when available). (3) Scale Events: timeline of scale up/down events with reason labels (reactive_queue, reactive_saturation, predictive_bias, cooldown_blocked, bounded_max, bounded_min), step size histogram, and oscillation score (event rate + direction flips). (4) Queueing & Latency: queue depth with overlays for bounded_max periods and p95 latency, plus request rate and token throughput. (5) Drilldown: a templated view keyed by customer_id + deployment_id + region with a narrow time window and annotations for config changes + incident markers (manual annotation stream). Key metrics referenced (names expected from monorepo): redwood_dedicated_autoscaler_desired_replicas, redwood_dedicated_autoscaler_bounded_replicas, redwood_dedicated_autoscaler_bound_hit_total{bound="max|min"}, redwood_dedicated_queue_depth, redwood_dedicated_request_latency_ms_bucket, redwood_dedicated_predictor_forecast_qps, redwood_dedicated_observed_qps, redwood_dedicated_prediction_error_abs, redwood_dedicated_scale_event_total{direction="up|down",reason="..."}, redwood_dedicated_predictor_stale_total, redwood_dedicated_predictive_fallback_total.
testing_notes: Validated rendering in Grafana staging against synthetic series and a replayed pilot dataset snapshot. Verified templates: customer_id, deployment_id, region, model (optional). Ensured panels do not require high-cardinality labels beyond deployment_id (no request/session labels). Checked thresholds/units: queue depth as gauge, bound hit rates as per-second and per-interval %, prediction error as both absolute QPS and percent. Confirmed time ranges: Overview defaults to last 6h; Scale Events defaults to last 2h. Confirmed annotations show scale events via Loki stream when available; otherwise panels still render without annotations.
review_conversation: Allison Grant (review): Panels look right, but we should avoid showing both customer_id and deployment_id in every legend; legends are too noisy. Also please align variable names to our standard ($customer, $deployment, $region). Sergio Costa (author): Ack. Updated legend formats to prefer deployment_id by default and moved customer_id into panel description/tooltips; standardized variables across dashboards. Aisha Bello (review): Can we add a panel that directly answers “are we bounded-max and building queue?” for on-call triage? Also make sure p95 latency uses the Dedicated SLO histogram, not generic gateway latency. Sergio Costa (author): Added a ‘Bounded Max + Queue Buildup’ stat panel (30m window) with thresholds and a linked drilldown. Switched latency queries to redwood_dedicated_request_latency_ms_bucket. Rafael Mendes (review): Please add links to the runbook and mention what to do when min bound can’t be met due to region shortage. Also can we annotate config changes? Sergio Costa (author): Added runbook links in dashboard header and a note about ‘min unmet’ degraded state; added optional annotation query for scaling-policy audit events (falls back gracefully if stream isn’t present). Vanessa Ortiz (review): Prediction error panel: can we show forecast staleness explicitly and highlight when predictive fallback triggers? That’s been our pilot pain point. Sergio Costa (author): Added forecast staleness gauge and fallback counter with a 15m rolling sum; updated Predictive dashboard to show both series next to error metrics. Allison Grant (final): Approved after the legend cleanup and variable standardization. Rafael Mendes (final): Approved; please ensure prod folder naming matches our provisioning rules. Confirmed.
merge_outcome: Merged to main; dashboards will ship with the next observability-pack sync to prod. Follow-up alert rules tracked in pr-1941.
